verdict.rationale: Codex supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) to add local/remote third-party servers and 'plugins to connect Codex to your team's tools and data,' enabling integration of external agent/tool ecosystems into workflows; it also connects to GitHub, GitLab, Linear, and Slack as trigger sources. However, evidence focuses on tool/data connectors rather than partner-built 'agent apps' specifically, and the MCP server command itself is noted as deprecated in favor of a newer app server, indicating some integration instability.
